title: Integration TSX test is not excluded from the default test script
reasoning: The default test script excludes only '**/*.integration.test.ts', but the included integration test is named auth.test.tsx under an integration directory. As a result, npm run test will still pick it up even though integration tests appear intended to be separated from the default unit run, while npm run test:integration only targets app/queries/__tests__/*.integration.test.ts and also misses this file.
recommendation: Update the scripts to consistently include or exclude integration tests, for example exclude '**/*.integration.test.{ts,tsx}' and/or 'app/__tests__/integration/**' from npm run test, and include the TSX integration directory in npm run test:integration if it should remain an integration suite.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: This is a test runner selection/configuration issue; the test files themselves cannot detect that they are being run by the wrong npm script.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a lightweight CI check or npm script dry-run convention that verifies integration test globs include TSX files and that the default test command excludes the integration directory.
minimumFixScope: Adjust package.json test and test:integration globs to match the repository's actual integration test locations and extensions.
